title: Megabar Shocks on a Benchtop
abstract: Techniques to generate megabar (100 GPa) pressure are critical for the study of materials under extreme conditions. However, kJ-class lasers are typically needed to generate such extreme pressures. Here, we present a method to reach megabar pressure on a benchtop using only tens of mJ a few millijoules of laser pulse energy. The core of our method is the utilization of multiple laser rings of different diameters and time delays to additively excite a focusing shock wave. Using high-speed imaging and a streak camera, we measured the shock trajectory and inferred pressure, temperature and density using hydrocode simulation. Our shock compression efficiency, informed by hydrocode, has achieved 23 GPa/mJ. If scaled up, our method may enable high-energy-density experiments on a benchtop.

summaries.en: The paper presents a benchtop technique to generate megabar (∼100 GPa) shock pressures using only tens of millijoules of laser energy by additively driving a focusing shock with multiple laser rings of different diameters and timed delays, validated via high-speed imaging and streak-camera measurements and hydrocode-inferred shock trajectory, pressure, temperature, and density, achieving a compression efficiency of 23 GPa/mJ and suggesting scalability for high-energy-density experiments.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种在桌面装置上通过使用仅几十毫焦的激光能量来实现兆巴（约100 GPa）冲击压力的方法，其核心是利用不同直径的多圈激光及其时间延迟对聚焦冲击波进行叠加激发，并通过高速成像与条纹相机测量冲击轨迹、结合水动力代码推断压力、温度和密度，最终得到冲击压缩效率为23 GPa/mJ，表明该方法若放大可用于桌面上的高能密度实验。

title: Monte Carlo Framework for Physics-Based Design and Optimization of X-Ray Compressive Ghost Imaging Systems
abstract: X-ray ghost imaging has emerged as a promising computational imaging modality capable of forming images from spatially integrated measurements. Unlike optical implementations, image formation is governed by multiple energy-dependent photon-matter interactions: photoelectric absorption, Compton scattering, and fluorescence. The relative contributions of these interactions depend on the source spectrum, sample geometry and composition, and detector configuration. We present a FLUKA-based Monte Carlo framework that models photon transport and predicts bucket signals generated by binary illumination patterns. The framework couples a physical scaling analysis, which converts the simulated bucket signals into photon numbers, tube loading and absorbed dose, with a ghost imaging reconstruction analysis of image quality and convergence. Our framework helps assess whether a given configuration is limited by the source output, the mask modulation or the reconstruction before any measurement is made. We evaluate the reconstruction for a centimeter-scale imaging system for an iron crown using one transmission detector and three off-axis scattering detectors over a range of source spectra. The results reveal how source characteristics and detector geometry influence reconstruction quality and radiation dose, providing quantitative guidelines for future X-ray ghost imaging system design. More broadly, this work establishes a predictive design framework for application-specific X-ray ghost imaging systems.

summaries.en: The paper presents a FLUKA-based Monte Carlo framework that models energy-dependent X-ray interactions to predict bucket signals from binary patterns, couples physical scaling to estimate photon numbers, tube loading, and absorbed dose, and uses ghost-imaging reconstruction analysis to quantify how source spectra and detector geometry affect image quality and convergence for a centimeter-scale iron-crown system, yielding design guidelines for application-specific X-ray compressive ghost imaging.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种基于FLUKA的蒙特卡洛框架，模拟能量相关的X射线相互作用以预测由二值掩模产生的桶信号，并将物理缩放分析与鬼成像重建评估相结合以估算光子数、管负载和吸收剂量，同时量化源谱与探测器几何对图像质量和收敛的影响，最终为面向特定应用的X射线压缩鬼成像系统设计给出定量指导。

title: Nonreciprocal Control of Spatiotemporal Floquet Dynamics in Levitated Optomechanical Arrays
abstract: Periodically driven photonic and optomechanical systems provide a versatile setting for realizing collective Floquet dynamics, yet the relation between temporal locking and continuous rotation of the finite-$q$ pattern remains poorly understood. We show that a nonreciprocal ring of parametrically driven optically levitated particles allows the spatial phase to be controlled while collective temporal locking is preserved. Nonreciprocity polarizes the counterpropagating finite-wave-vector modes and drives a transition from the pinned state to persistent directional spatial-phase drift. The normalized spatial-phase drift velocity is independently encoded in the splitting of the two dominant spectral branches, and its direction reverses with the coupling asymmetry. The pinned regime exhibits a laboratory frame period-two time-crystalline response, whereas the rotating regime forms a distinct temporally locked spatiotemporally ordered state. The same correspondence between spatial-phase drift and spectral splitting persists down to few-particle rings, indicating that the effect does not require a large array. These results establish nonreciprocity as a route to independently control spatial-phase drift and temporal synchronization in driven levitated optomechanical systems.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates that a nonreciprocal ring of parametrically driven levitated optomechanical particles can independently control the spatial-phase evolution of collective finite-wave-vector Floquet dynamics while preserving temporal locking, with direction-dependent persistent phase drift arising from polarization of counterpropagating modes and quantified by spectral-branch splitting that reverses with coupling asymmetry.
summaries.zh: 本文表明，利用非互易的参数驱动悬浮光学微机械粒子环，可以在保持集体时间锁定的同时独立控制有限波矢Floquet动力学的空间相位演化；非互易通过极化相向传播的模式促成从固定态到持续定向空间相位漂移的转变，漂移方向由耦合不对称决定，并可通过主导谱分支的分裂来表征，且该对应关系在少粒子环中同样成立。

title: Watt-level single-cavity dual-comb laser at 2.1 $μ$m wavelength
abstract: Compact ultrafast laser combs around the 2 $\mu$m atmospheric transmission window are of growing interest for direct spectroscopy and as drivers for nonlinear conversion to otherwise hard-to-reach spectral regions. Dual-comb systems in this region remain very scarce: existing implementations rely mostly on nonlinear conversion, resulting in complex systems with poor conversion efficiency and overall low average and peak power. In this paper, we report on a watt-level dual-comb laser directly emitting at 2.1 $\mu$m. The system is based on a single-cavity, soft-aperture Kerr-lens mode-locked (KLM) laser using a broadband holmium (Ho)-doped CaAlGdO$_4$ (CALGO) gain crystal. The laser delivers a total output power exceeding 2 W (1 W per comb) with a sub-100-fs pulse duration (50 nm bandwidth) at a repetition rate of 96.5 MHz, corresponding to a pulse energy of 10 nJ and a peak power of 100 kW per comb. To assess the source's potential for future spectroscopic applications, we characterize the free-running dual comb in detail for frequency stability, phase noise, and relative intensity noise (RIN), and benchmark the achievable spectral resolution by measuring spectral modulations imposed by Fabry-Pérot etalons. Our system combines the compactness, high efficiency, and passive mutual coherence of a single-cavity oscillator with watt-level average power at 2.1 $\mu$m, making it a promising source for environmental sensing in the atmospheric transmission window, or as a driver for nonlinear frequency conversion, for example, to the MIR and THz regions.

title: Ablation-Driven Selective Laser Direct Mass Transfer for Micro-LEDs with High Speed, Enhanced Gap Tolerance, and High Precision
abstract: Micro light-emitting diodes (micro-LEDs) offer superior performance for next-generation displays, yet their scalable manufacturing is severely bottlenecked by the mass transfer process from donor to receiver substrates. The existing laser-induced forward transfer (LIFT) methods are restricted by low throughput, limited selectivity, and long reaction times. In this study, we introduce a novel defocused direct laser ablation transfer (D-DLAT) method utilizing polyimide as a dynamic release layer. Whereas most indirect laser transfer methods trigger chip release followed by passive descent toward the receiver, D-DLAT directly ablates the release layer to actively propel the small-sized chips towards the receiver via ablation shock. By optimizing the ablation profiles and scanning paths, this method achieves high-speed transfer with significantly enhanced precision and robustness. We demonstrate the successful transfer of micro-LEDs ranging from 600 $\unicode{x03BC}$m down to 35 $\unicode{x03BC}$m in size, with a minimum reported placement error of less than 1 $\unicode{x03BC}$m, and a critical transfer gap of up to 50 $\unicode{x03BC}$m. Furthermore, the D-DLAT approach enables full selectivity, facilitating complex patterned transfers and array repitching operations that are essential for full-color display integration. Our findings indicate that D-DLAT effectively overcomes the fundamental limitations of current transfer technologies, demonstrating substantial potential for the scalable and high-yield manufacturing of advanced micro-LED displays. Ultimately, D-DLAT establishes a robust paradigm for the high-speed manipulation and heterogeneous integration of micro-optoelectronic devices, extending its profound implications beyond displays to the broader landscape of advanced micro-assembly and flexible electronics.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a defocused direct laser ablation transfer (D-DLAT) technique using a polyimide dynamic release layer that actively ablates and propels micro-LED chips for high-speed, highly selective mass transfer with sub-micron placement error and up to 50 μm gap tolerance, enabling precise patterned and array repitching transfers for scalable micro-LED display manufacturing.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了一种利用聚酰亚胺动态释放层的去聚焦直接激光烧蚀转移（D-DLAT）方法，通过直接烧蚀并主动推进微型LED芯片实现高速、全选择性的批量转移，其放置误差可达亚微米级且转移间隙容忍度最高可达50 μm，从而支持复杂图案与阵列重排转移并为可规模化的微型LED显示器制造提供潜力。

title: Optical Coherent Combining in Multi-Aperture Free-Space Receivers through Atmospheric Turbulence via Optically Computed Alignment Gradients
abstract: Multi-aperture reception converts spatial diversity into a coherent-combining gain, but only if the relative phase and polarization of the collected field replicas are aligned before they are summed. In a satellite-to-ground downlink the atmosphere perturbs amplitude, phase and polarization, so the alignment must track a fluctuating channel rather than a fixed offset. This paper proposes a new optical-domain combining scheme in which the alignment information is computed by light itself: the ascent directions that maximize the combined output power are formed by optical interference and read out directly as differential photocurrents of balanced detection, so no estimate of the channel, no deliberate perturbation, and no per-branch digital processing is needed to obtain them. Every branch is aligned against one shared reference - a passive tap of the combined field itself - so no independent laser or optical frequency lock is required, and the update directions of all branches are available simultaneously in a single averaging window without frequency, code, or time multiplexing. The data path needs a single dual-polarization coherent receiver regardless of the aperture count, and the readout is built from elementary parts only - a 3 dB directional coupler, static phase shifters, a Faraday rotator, and balanced photodiodes - so no 90-degree optical hybrid, mixer, or polarization-diverse hybrid is required. The phase and polarization loops are fixed-gain and division-free, and each branch carries one phase modulator and one polarization controller with no amplitude actuator. A closed-form combining-gain and loss budget is derived, the assumptions and limitations of the scheme are stated explicitly, and experimental validation remains open.

summaries.en: The paper proposes an optical-domain coherent combining receiver for multi-aperture free-space downlinks that uses optically generated alignment gradients from interference and balanced detection to track atmospheric turbulence without explicit channel estimation, deliberate perturbations, or per-branch digital processing, while using a simple dual-polarization coherent receiver architecture and deriving a combining-gain/loss budget.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出一种用于多孔径自由空间下行的光域相干合束接收方案，通过光学干涉与平衡探测直接产生并读取“对准梯度”来跟踪大气湍流，从而无需信道估计、无需刻意扰动、也无需每个支路的独立数字处理，并推导了合束增益与损耗预算且给出了假设与局限（实验验证仍未完成）。

title: Frequency comb stability, bistability, and self-starting in normal dispersion microresonators
abstract: Recent work has demonstrated that it is possible to generate frequency combs in normal dispersion microresonators by taking advantage of fabricated mode coupling that induces a mode split. In particular, photonic crystal resonators periodically modulate the microresonator's width, which geometrically creates mode coupling. In contrast to frequency combs generated by microresonators in the anomalous dispersion regime, which are typically generated using bright solitons, the frequency combs generated by normal dispersion regime microresonators are dark pulses that are commonly referred to as dark solitons or platicons. In this work, we examine the linear stability of platicons in the pump-detuning and pump-power parameter space as the mode split strength and cavity dispersion is varied. Our work reveals a broad region of stability for platicons. Our work also reveals the existence of fingers at high power at whose boundaries a sharp transition occurs and inside of which platicon solutions are bistable. Finally, we investigate the overlap of the region where platicons are stable with the region where continuous waves are modulationally unstable, and it is possible for a platicon to self-start. Simulations show that platicons consistently self-start inside this region.

summaries.en: The paper maps the linear stability of normal-dispersion platicon (dark-soliton) frequency combs in microresonators with mode splitting, finding broad stability regions with high-power bistable “fingers” and showing that their overlap with the modulational-instability region of continuous waves enables platicon self-starting consistently in simulations.
summaries.zh: 本文在具有模式分裂的正常色散微谐振器中，分析了平台顿（暗孤子）频率梳的线性稳定性，发现平台顿存在宽广的稳定区域，并在高功率下出现边界发生急剧转变且内部存在双稳态的“指状区域”，同时表明其稳定区域与连续波的调制不稳定区重叠可使平台顿实现自启动，仿真显示其能在该区域内稳定自启动。

title: The role of friction on heave-induced motion of offshore drilling systems: modelling, analysis, and numerical experiments
abstract: This paper investigates the influence of friction dynamics on heave-induced disturbance propagation using a coupled hydraulic-structural drilling model formulated as a semilinear interconnection of ordinary and hyperbolic partial differential equations (ODE-PDEs), and capturing spatially distributed memory effects in the drillstring-wellbore interaction. First, local and global existence and uniqueness results are established, and sufficient conditions for boundedness and input-to-state stability are deduced via a small-gain analysis. Subsequently, extensive numerical investigations are carried out, including harmonic excitation studies, nonlinear distortion analysis, spatial amplification investigations, mechanism-isolation experiments, parameter sensitivity analysis, and broadband simulations under realistic offshore sea-state excitation. The simulation results indicate that, whilst the hydraulic response is governed primarily by wave propagation phenomena, compressibility, and boundary reflections, the structural dynamics display substantially greater sensitivity to distributed friction effects. Furthermore, drillstring-wellbore friction is shown to have a relatively limited influence on well-posedness but a potentially significant impact on stability margins. These findings highlight the importance of accounting for coupled hydraulic-structural dynamics and distributed friction mechanisms when analysing, monitoring, and controlling offshore drilling systems.
subjects: Applied Physics (physics.app-ph) ; Systems and Control (eess.SY); Dynamical Systems (math.DS)

summaries.en: The paper models offshore drilling heave disturbances with a coupled hydraulic-structural ODE–PDE system with distributed memory, proves existence/uniqueness and derives boundedness and input-to-state stability via small-gain analysis, then uses extensive simulations to show hydraulic behavior is mainly wave/compressibility/boundary-reflection dominated while structural dynamics are highly sensitive to distributed friction, which weakly affects well-posedness but can significantly reduce stability margins.
summaries.zh: 本文建立耦合水力-结构ODE–PDE的海上钻井系统模型以刻画由升沉引起扰动的传播并引入钻杆-井筒相互作用中的分布式记忆效应，给出存在唯一性及基于小增益分析的有界性与输入到状态稳定性条件，并通过大量数值仿真表明：水力响应主要受波传播、可压缩性与边界反射支配，而结构动力学对分布式摩擦更敏感，摩擦对良态性影响相对有限但可能显著削弱稳定裕度，从而强调分析、监测与控制中必须考虑耦合动力学及分布式摩擦机制。

title: Mechanical trisqueezing in circuit quantum acoustodynamics with SNAIL devices
abstract: Continuous-variable quantum information processing with mechanical oscillators requires a uni- versal gate set, including a genuine non-Gaussian evolution. While circuit quantum acoustodynamics (cQAD) experiments have realized bilinear and quartic (four-wave mixing) operations by coupling mechanical modes to transmon qubits, the intrinsic Kerr nonlinearity of these devices precludes access to odd-order effective Hamiltonians such as trisqueezing. Here we propose a cQAD architec- ture in which a mechanical mode, hosted in a high-overtone bulk acoustic-wave resonator (HBAR), is coupled to a superconducting nonlinear asymmetric inductive element (SNAIL). By combining the cubic nonlinearity of the SNAIL with parametric flux driving, we engineer a three-wave mixing interaction that generates trisqueezed mechanical states, producing the characteristic triangular, star-shaped Wigner function with negative regions indicative of non-Gaussianity. We derive the effective trisqueezing Hamiltonian from the full circuit model, identify the drive frequencies and flux modulation required to isolate the desired interaction from competing terms, and quantify the achievable coupling strengths for parameters compatible with current fabrication capabilities. Our results establish a hardware-efficient route to non-Gaussian resource generation in mechanical quantum systems, extending the toolbox of cQAD toward universal continuous-variable quantum computation and enhanced quantum-limited sensing.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a circuit quantum acoustodynamics architecture that couples a high-overtone mechanical resonator to a SNAIL device to use its cubic nonlinearity, together with parametric flux driving, to engineer a three-wave-mixing interaction producing trisqueezed non-Gaussian mechanical states and provides the derived effective Hamiltonian, required drive conditions, and feasible coupling strengths for current fabrication.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了一种电路量子声学动力学（cQAD）方案：将高谐振频体声波谐振器中的机械模与SNAIL非线性非对称电感器耦合，并结合SNAIL的三次非线性与参数化磁通驱动，工程化三波混频相互作用以生成三挤压（trisquueezing）的非高斯机械态；论文推导了有效三挤压哈密顿量，给出为隔离目标相互作用所需的驱动频率与磁通调制条件，并量化了在现有器件加工能力范围内可实现的耦合强度。

title: Quantum Partial Information Decompositions, an Operational Order on Ensembles, and Direct Quantifications of Objective Information
abstract: The partial information decomposition (PID) framework is an extension of classical information theory that enables a systematic analysis of the structure of information in multipartite systems. We advance a simple extension of this framework enabling the construction of multipartite quantum PIDs (QPIDs); generalizing recent, exclusively bipartite, extensions. We construct two QPIDs of the Holevo quantity. First a naive QPID based on the classical minimum mutual information. Second a sophisticated QPID enabled by our development of an operational partial order on quantum ensembles in terms of ensemble (inter-)convertability. Finally, as a concrete example of how QPIDs can be applied, we investigate objectivity scenarios; using our Holevo QPIDs to directly quantify objective information in extended graph states. These findings ultimately establish a foundation upon which generic multipartite QPIDs can be systematically constructed, introduce an operational partial order on ensembles, advance QPIDs as interesting objects of study in their own right, and demonstrate their immediate applicability to problems in quantum information.

summaries.en: The paper extends partial information decomposition to multipartite quantum systems by constructing quantum PIDs for the Holevo quantity, introducing an operational partial order on quantum ensembles based on ensemble convertibility, and applying these QPIDs to directly quantify objective information in graph-state objectivity scenarios.
summaries.zh: 论文将部分信息分解框架扩展到多体量子系统，构造了用于Holevo量的多方量子PID，引入了基于集合（不可/可）转换性的量子集合操作性偏序，并在扩展图态的客观性情景中用这些量子PID直接度量客观信息，从而为一般多方量子PID的系统构建奠定基础。

title: Standard and Bipolar Rectification in Tilted Periodically-Driven Quantum Systems
abstract: Developing mechanisms to control transport in correlated quantum systems is essential for advancing quantum circuit technologies. In this work, we establish a rectification mechanism for both particle and energy flow in a fermionic system coupled to external baths, in the presence of a tilted potential modulated locally by a time-periodic drive. The drive generates particle and energy currents even in the absence of chemical or thermal bias between the baths. These drive-induced currents are enhanced at resonant frequencies at which avoided crossings occur in the Floquet quasienergy spectrum, reflecting the role of the Floquet states as intermediate channels for transport. Once a bias between the baths is introduced, the drive-induced current contribution can reinforce, compete with, or even cancel the bias-induced contribution. These effects enable rectification in the non-interacting regime, which we quantify via the rectification coefficient $\mathcal{R}$. This coefficient measures the asymmetry between transport up the tilt (forward bias) and down the tilt (reverse bias). In addition to standard rectification, where transport is reduced under reverse bias, we identify a regime of bipolar rectification, in which the current flows only up the tilt regardless of the bias polarity. At the boundary between standard and bipolar regimes, the system achieves perfect rectification, corresponding to complete suppression of the reverse-bias current. In the presence of interactions between particles, the parameter region that supports bipolar rectification is enlarged and $\mathcal{R}$ can be enhanced by many orders of magnitude. Our results establish a rectification mechanism for particle and energy transport that can be experimentally realized in condensed matter and cold atom systems.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall); Statistical Mechanics (cond-mat.stat-mech)

summaries.en: The paper shows that a local time-periodic (Floquet) drive acting on a tilted fermionic quantum system connected to baths can generate and spectrally enhance particle and energy currents without initial bias, and that when bias is applied it leads to standard or bipolar rectification—quantified by a rectification coefficient—where currents can be forced to flow only up the tilt, with interactions enlarging the bipolar regime and strongly increasing rectification.
summaries.zh: 论文表明，在耦接外部浴的倾斜费米子量子系统中施加局域时间周期驱动（Floquet）可在无化学势或温度偏置时产生并在Floquet准能隙发生回避交叉的共振频率处放大粒子与能量流；当施加浴间偏置后，驱动诱导的电流会与偏置诱导分量相互增强、竞争甚至抵消，从而实现用整流系数衡量的标准或双极整流——在双极整流中不论偏置极性电流只沿倾斜方向向上流，并且在两种整流边界处可实现完美整流；粒子相互作用会扩大双极整流参数区域并使整流系数提升多个数量级。

title: Syndrome-Resolved Decoding of Qubit Readout Errors
abstract: Readout errors in superconducting qubits include incorrect state assignment, bit flips within the computational subspace, and leakage to non-computational states. These errors require different mitigation strategies, yet conventional measurement fidelity and repeatability metrics do not resolve their individual contributions. Previous repeated-readout studies have shown that temporal correlations reveal additional information about readout errors. Here we introduce the Readout Error Decoder (RED), which converts repeated thresholded binary records into a channel-resolved error budget. Controlled error injections validate the channel-specific response of the decoder. We demonstrate RED on both fluxonium and transmon qubits and across distinct leakage-lifetime regimes. RED identifies the error channels limiting readout performance without requiring dedicated discrimination of non-computational states, providing a basis for targeted readout optimization across different qubit modalities.

summaries.en: The paper presents the Readout Error Decoder (RED), which uses syndrome-resolved processing of repeated thresholded readout results to decompose superconducting-qubit measurement errors into distinct channels (misassignment, in-subspace bit flips, and leakage) and uses controlled injections to validate the channel-resolved error budgets on fluxonium and transmon qubits across leakage regimes for targeted readout optimization.
summaries.zh: 本文提出读取误差解码器（RED），通过对重复阈值化读出记录进行综合罪矢解析处理，将超导量子比特的测量误差分解为不同通道（态分配错误、计算子空间内比特翻转和泄漏），并通过受控误差注入验证其通道分辨的误差预算，在不同泄漏寿命区间对通量量子和跨量子比特进行演示，从而无需专门区分非计算态即可为定向读出优化提供依据。

title: Perfect and peak state transfer on IBM quantum hardware
abstract: We run continuous-time quantum walks with perfect and peak state transfer on a present-day superconducting quantum processor, IBM Quantum's $156$-qubit Heron device ibm_kingston, deliberately without error correction or error mitigation. Perfect state transfer and its relaxations have been studied extensively in algebraic graph theory, where one can prove exactly which graphs move a quantum state from one vertex to another with probability one (or with the largest probability the graph allows, in the case of peak state transfer), and at what time. Our experiments cover perfect state transfer on the hypercubes $Q_2 = C_4$ and $Q_3$, and on the Hamming-weighted paths $\mathrm{HP}_n$, the equitable-partition quotients of the hypercubes $Q_n$, for $n$ up to $20$; peak state transfer on the $X_n$ family for $n$ up to $11$; and, for comparison, moving the state along a path of qubits by a sequence of SWAP gates.

summaries.en: The paper experimentally demonstrates continuous-time quantum walks achieving perfect or peak quantum state transfer on IBM’s 156-qubit superconducting processor without error correction or mitigation, testing specific graph families (hypercubes, Hamming-weighted paths, and Xn peak-transfer graphs) up to given sizes and comparing performance to SWAP-gate state propagation along qubit paths.
summaries.zh: 论文在不使用纠错或误差缓解的情况下，利用 IBM 156 量子比特超导处理器通过连续时间量子游走实现并实验验证完美或峰值量子态转移，测试了超立方体、加权汉明路径以及 Xn 系列峰值转移等特定图族的不同规模结果，并与沿量子比特链逐步施加 SWAP 门的传输方案进行了对比。

title: monoprop: Scaling Pauli and Majorana propagation via Anticommutation Indices
abstract: We introduce monoprop, an open-source, massively parallel operator-propagation framework for fermion and qubit bases. For $N$ qubits or modes, existing codes represent each of the $K$ tracked operator terms (Pauli strings or products of Majorana operators) as a $2N$-bit string, testing each for anticommutation with the gate at $O(KN)$ cost per gate. Here, we introduce the anticommutation index which rapidly looks up the terms anticommuting with a gate. A local gate changes only the terms that touch its sites, and when terms are truncated to act on few sites, only a fraction $\sim1/N$ touch any given qubit or mode, and we use this to prove the time per gate scales as $O(K/N)$. This counterintuitive result tells us that for a fixed number of terms, increasing the number of sites can make things faster. We demonstrate this numerically, and show monoprop scales almost ideally to 8192 cores, tracking $9.5\times10^{10}$ terms. Beyond propagation, we present memory-efficient surrogate graphs, which record one propagation and replay it at new angles, for fast energy re-estimation and parameter gradients, and an efficient method for finding energy-minimising gates and optimal angles for simulating adaptive quantum-chemistry circuits.

summaries.en: The paper presents monoprop, an open-source massively parallel framework that speeds Pauli and Majorana operator propagation by using an anticommutation-index lookup to reduce per-gate time to O(K/N), achieving near-ideal scaling to 8192 cores while tracking 9.
summaries.zh: 本文提出开源的单传播（monoprop）框架，通过引入“反对易指标”来快速查找与量子门相反对易的算符项，从而把每个门的传播时间从O(KN)降低到O(K/N)，并在8192个核心上实现近理想加速、追踪9.

title: Optimising multipartite entanglement manipulation in quantum networks
abstract: Long-range, genuine multipartite entanglement (GME) between distant parties in a quantum network is a crucial resource for distributed quantum information processing. Through controlled manipulation of short-range GME states in the network via stochastic local operations aided by classical communication (SLOCC), long-range GME can be established between selected target nodes on demand. Optimizing such multipartite entanglement distribution protocols under constraints imposed by the network architecture, target-node set, and available resource budget is a key challenge in resource-efficient manipulation of GME. We present a general operational framework for manipulating GME in quantum networks by classifying the relevant networking operations into three broad primitives-inflation, deflation, and purification-reflecting their effect on the proliferation of GME through general bounds and illustrative examples. We show how these primitives can be combined to construct a broad class of multipartite quantum repeater protocols, enabling their systematic optimization, and demonstrate the framework with a simple example. Applying our approach to networks of Dür-Cirac-Tarrach states reveals a rich landscape of achievable end-to-end GME and accessible entanglement classes. More generally, our framework provides a systematic approach to the construction and optimization of multipartite quantum repeater protocols for scalable and resource-efficient GME distribution in quantum networks.

summaries.en: The paper develops a general operational framework—based on the primitives inflation, deflation, and purification—for optimizing SLOCC-based manipulation of short-range genuine multipartite entanglement in quantum networks so as to efficiently generate long-range GME between chosen target nodes under resource and architectural constraints, illustrated via multipartite quantum repeater protocols and applications to Dür-Cirac-Tarrach state networks.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出了一个通用操作框架，通过“膨胀（inflation）”“收缩（deflation）”和“纯化（purification）”三种基本原语来刻画并优化在量子网络中利用SLOCC对短程真正多体纠缠进行操控，从而在资源与网络架构约束下按需在指定目标节点之间建立长程GME，并通过构造多体量子中继协议及对Dür-Cirac-Tarrach态网络的应用展示其可达终端GME格局与可用纠缠类别。

title: Crossovers between Time-Bin and Energy-Time Entanglement in Homodyned Resonance Fluorescence
abstract: We theoretically investigate photonic entanglement generated by homodyning resonance fluorescence from a two-level emitter with a phase-locked laser field. Under weak excitation, increasing the relative laser-field amplitude produces crossovers from time-bin to energy--time and back to time-bin entanglement. The intermediate energy--time regime occurs near amplitude matching, where destructive interference suppresses the single-photon component, allowing the two-photon contributions to dominate the coincidence signal. We evaluate the resulting photon statistics and first-order coherence and characterize the entanglement through violations of the CHSH Bell inequality in a Franson interferometer. This scheme provides a route to controlling photonic entanglement through linear optics and coherent interference.

summaries.en: The paper theoretically shows that homodyne-detected resonance fluorescence from a phase-locked two-level emitter exhibits tunable photonic entanglement that crossovers between time-bin and energy-time forms as the relative laser amplitude varies, with an intermediate energy-time regime near amplitude matching where destructive interference suppresses single-photon events and enhances two-photon coincidences, allowing CHSH-violating entanglement to be characterized in a Franson interferometer via photon statistics and coherence.
summaries.zh: 论文从理论上表明，使用相位锁定的两能级发射器进行同频（同相检测）共振荧光实验时，随着相对激光场幅度的变化产生可调的光子纠缠形态，在时间-比特与能量-时间纠缠之间发生交叉；在幅度匹配附近的中间能量-时间区间，单光子分量因相消干涉而被抑制，从而使双光子贡献主导符合计数，进而结合光子统计与一阶相干性，并在法朗（Franson）干涉仪中通过对CHSH贝尔不等式的违背来刻画纠缠。

title: Finite-Frequency Boson-Number Bounds Across the Quantum Rabi Transition
abstract: We consider the quantum Rabi model, a fundamental model of quantum optics describing a two-level system coupled to a bosonic mode, including counter-rotating terms. In the limit of large separation between the two-level transition frequency and the bosonic mode frequency, the model exhibits a quantum phase transition at a critical coupling strength. Although the model is exactly solvable, simple analytic expressions for important physical quantities are generally unavailable. We derive rigorous upper and lower bounds for the ground-state energy and boson occupation number across the quantum phase transition at finite frequency ratios. Our results characterize the subcritical, critical, and supercritical regimes and establish the scaling behavior of the boson occupation near the critical point. Exact numerical diagonalization demonstrates the tightness of the derived bounds, while the resulting finite-frequency inequalities provide experimentally testable predictions for trapped-ion quantum simulators.

summaries.en: The paper derives rigorous finite-frequency upper and lower bounds on the ground-state energy and boson number for the quantum Rabi model across its quantum phase transition, clarifying subcritical/critical/supercritical regimes and the scaling of boson occupation near criticality, with tightness verified by numerical diagonalization and predictions suited to trapped-ion quantum simulators.
summaries.zh: 论文在有限频率比条件下，为量子臂振模型跨越量子相变推导了基态能量与玻色子占据数的严格上、下界，刻画了亚临界/临界/超临界区间并给出临界点附近玻色子占据的标度行为，通过数值对角化验证界的紧致性，并提出可供囚禁离子量子模拟器实验检验的预测。

title: Time-optimal robust quantum control for partially known errors
abstract: Robust quantum control usually assumes one of two extremes: the error is of a known form and only its strength is unknown, or nothing at all is known about it. In practice one often sits in between. The size of a static error is unknown, but its class is known, for example, it only shifts energy levels, or it acts on each subsystem separately. We ask how fast a control can cancel, to first order, every error in such a class. A time-independent Hamiltonian can do this if and only if all errors in the class have zero diagonal in a common basis. In that case an equally spaced energy ladder in this basis does it after one period. A lower bound that holds for any time-dependent control with bounded drive power shows that this simple constant control is optimal for several natural classes, including unknown level shifts and unknown local errors on two subsystems. Completely unknown errors need a time-dependent control, and there, knowing the error class shortens the minimum time by a factor $\sqrt{d^2+1}$. So partial knowledge of the error changes not only how long an optimal robust control takes, but also its form.

summaries.en: The paper derives time-optimal robust quantum control strategies for errors that are only partially known, showing when a constant Hamiltonian can cancel an entire known error class and proving lower bounds that make such constant controls optimal for several cases, while demonstrating that fully unknown errors require time-dependent control and that knowing the error class reduces the minimum time by a factor of √(d²+1).
summaries.zh: 本文研究对“部分已知”的量子误差进行时间最优的鲁棒量子控制，指出当误差类在某共同基底下对角元全为零时可由常值哈密顿量在一个周期内抵消，并通过适用于任意有界驱动功率的控制的下界证明在多类情形下该常值控制是最优的；同时表明完全未知误差必须使用时间依赖控制，而一旦知道误差类别，最短时间会按 √(d²+1) 的因子缩短。

title: Size-Dependent High-Order Harmonic Generation from Linear Carbon-Chain Molecules in Linearly Polarized Laser Fields
abstract: High-order harmonic generation from molecules is highly sensitive to molecular geometry and strong-field electron dynamics, providing a powerful route for probing and controlling ultrafast processes in extended systems. In this work, we systematically investigate the influence of molecular chain length on HHG from linear carbon-chain molecules C$_2$H$_2$, C$_6$H$_2$, and C$_{10}$H$_2$ driven by an 800 nm linearly polarized laser field. To isolate the molecular-size effect from the influence of different ionization potentials, the laser intensities are adjusted to maintain the same Keldysh parameter for different molecules. Real-time time-dependent density functional theory simulations are performed with the molecular axis aligned parallel to the laser polarization direction. The results show that increasing the molecular chain length significantly enhances the harmonic yield and tends to extend the cutoff region. In particular, C$_{10}$H$_2$ exhibits much stronger plateau harmonics than C$_2$H$_2$, while the intermediate molecule C$_6$H$_2$ shows harmonic intensities between those of C$_2$H$_2$ and C$_{10}$H$_2$. Time-frequency analysis and charge-density evolution reveal that the enhanced HHG emission in longer chains originates from the enlarged electron acceleration distance and increased probability of multi-center recollision, especially near the terminal carbon atoms. These findings demonstrate that molecular-size engineering offers an effective strategy for controlling harmonic emission and optimizing attosecond light sources in extended molecular systems.

summaries.en: Using time-dependent density functional theory for linear carbon-chain molecules (C2H2, C6H2, C10H2) driven by an 800 nm linearly polarized laser at equal Keldysh parameter, the paper shows that increasing chain length strongly boosts high-order harmonic yields and extends the cutoff due to larger electron acceleration distance and more likely multi-center recollisions, especially near terminal carbon atoms.
summaries.zh: 该论文在保持相同Keldysh参量条件下，采用与800 nm线偏激光驱动相对应的时域密度泛函理论研究线性碳链分子（C2H2、C6H2、C10H2），结果表明链长增加会显著增强高次谐波产率并延长截止区域，其原因在于更大的电子加速距离以及多中心再碰撞概率的提高（尤其发生在端基碳原子附近）。

title: Remote Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill Entanglement Generation between Trapped Ions
abstract: Distributing entanglement directly between error-corrected logical qubits is an important capability for scalable quantum networks. We propose a heralded protocol for generating remote entanglement between Gottesman--Kitaev--Preskill qubits encoded in the motional modes of spatially separated trapped ions, using the internal electronic states to interface the motional qubits with emitted photons. We derive the protocol for single-rail and polarization photonic encodings and evaluate the effects of finite GKP squeezing, photon loss, photon recoil, motional heating, and motional dephasing on the decoded logical state. Moreover, we numerically analysed the fidelity of distributed logical Bell-pair fidelity. We find that one can achieve more than 95% of fidelity in the realistic situation. The protocol combines motional-control and photonic-networking operations that have already been demonstrated in trapped-ion experiments.

summaries.en: The paper proposes and analyzes a heralded remote-entanglement protocol that generates high-fidelity entanglement between GKP (Gottesman–Kitaev–Preskill) logical qubits encoded in motional modes of spatially separated trapped ions using photon-mediated interactions, accounting for realistic noise sources and showing that distributed logical Bell pairs can achieve over 95% fidelity.
summaries.zh: 本文提出并分析了一种保真度较高的远程纠缠产生方案，通过利用被空间分离的陷阱离子中以运动自由度编码的 GKP 逻辑比特，并借助光子介导的相互作用实现保检（heralded）纠缠，同时评估有限 GKP 挤压、光子损失、反冲以及运动退相干/加热等现实误差对解码逻辑态的影响，并通过数值计算表明分布式逻辑贝尔对保真度在现实条件下可超过 95%。

title: Controlled-Memory Identification with Shared Generators: Dimension--Horizon Tradeoffs and Quantum--Classical Separation
abstract: We determine the finite-horizon identification limits of a \(d\)-dimensional memory when the control interface is restricted to four shared, time-homogeneous generators. A writer encodes a message by applying a prefix word to a common root state. The verifier then applies a candidate-dependent query word followed by a shared terminal binary test, with each word of length at most \(T\). For fixed error tolerances \(\lambda_2>0\) and \(\lambda_1+\lambda_2<1\), the optimal identification sizes satisfy \(\ln N_{\mathsf Q,4}=\Theta_{\lambda_1,\lambda_2}(\min\{d^2,T\})\) for arbitrary CPTP generators and \(\ln N_{\mathsf S,4}=\Theta_{\lambda_1,\lambda_2}(\min\{d,T\})\) for stochastic maps. Four unitary letters and four permutation letters attain these respective bounds, showing that a four-letter reversible alphabet reaches the static code-size orders in optimal quadratic and linear word length. In the fully dimension-limited regime, this yields \(\ln N_{\mathsf Q,4}=\Theta(d^2)\) versus \(\ln N_{\mathsf S,4}=\Theta(d)\), establishing a quadratic quantum--classical separation in logarithmic code size. Low-overlap Grassmann and agreement-code packings supply the orbit endpoints, while exact inverse query words match each encoded state to its designated test. At the sharp boundary \(\lambda_2=0\), \(0\leq\lambda_1<1\), all four model classes satisfy \(\ln N=\Theta(\min\{\ln d,T\})\). Thus any fixed positive false-acceptance tolerance activates the metric-packing regime, whereas zero false acceptance imposes an exclusive-witness constraint and yields the logarithmic-dimension boundary.

summaries.en: The paper analyzes finite-horizon controlled-memory identification using a quantum/classical control interface constrained to four shared time-homogeneous generators, proving optimal identification sizes scale as ln N_{Q,4}=Θ(min{d^2,T}) for arbitrary CPTP maps and ln N_{S,4}=Θ(min{d,T}) for stochastic maps, thereby establishing a quadratic quantum–classical separation in logarithmic code length under dimension-limited conditions and characterizing different scaling behavior at the sharp boundary λ2=0 versus any positive false-acceptance tolerance.
summaries.zh: 论文研究在控制接口仅允许四个共享、时间齐次生成元的条件下的有限视界受控存储识别极限，证明对任意CPTP映射最优识别规模满足ln N_{Q,4}=Θ(min{d^2,T})，而对随机（stochastic）映射满足ln N_{S,4}=Θ(min{d,T})，从而在维度受限情形下给出对数编码长度上的二次量子—经典分离，并在λ2=0的临界边界处相较于任意正的假接受容忍度给出不同的缩放规律。

title: Three-axis Active Magnetic Compensation with Spatial Feedforward Matrix Decoupling and Hysteresis PI Regulation for Suppressing Zeeman Decoherence of Cold Atom Quantum Memories
abstract: Cold-atom quantum memories require a near-zero magnetic environment (residual field <1 microtesla) to mitigate Zeeman decoherence. Conventional three-axis active compensation suffers from inter-coil crosstalk and geomagnetic drift, which degrade the uniformity and long-term stability of the zero-field region. To address this, we propose a spatiotemporally cooperative feedback-controlled suppression architecture for magnetic interference. An integrally printed three-dimensional orthogonal coil frame mechanically suppresses inter-axis flux leakage. A spatial feedforward inverse matrix is introduced to algorithmically eliminate first-order cross-coupling. A dual-threshold hysteresis incremental-PI controller filters magnetometer quantization fluctuations and avoids frequent small jitter adjustments of coil driving currents. Hardware ablation experiments, long-duration stability tests and spatial magnetic-field mapping were conducted. Experimental results show that during a 714.4 s continuous steady-hold stage, the mean and maximum residual fields at the central point reach 0.112 microtesla and 0.224 microtesla, respectively. The overlapping Allan deviations of all three components remain below 5 nT for averaging times of 1.9-178.2 s. Based on differential-ferrofluid lattice-scan measurements combined with centre-constrained quadratic vector reconstruction and soft Maxwell regularization, a weak-field spatial distribution with an RMS variation of 5.65 microtesla is fitted within a spherical region of interest of radius 5 mm, where 67.5% of the model volume meets the sub-5 microtesla coverage criterion. For a prolate ellipsoidal region matching the atomic-cloud distribution with full axis lengths of 10, 5, and 5 mm, the upper field bound within 93.7% of the volume is 2.68 microtesla.

summaries.en: The paper presents a three-axis active magnetic compensation system for cold-atom quantum memories that combines a mechanically orthogonal coil frame, a spatial feedforward inverse-matrix to cancel first-order cross-coupling, and a dual-threshold hysteresis incremental-PI controller to suppress magnetometer quantization jitter, achieving 714.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了一套用于冷原子量子存储的三轴主动磁场补偿方案，集成了三维正交线圈框架（机械抑制串扰）、空间前馈逆矩阵算法（消除一阶交叉耦合）以及双阈值迟滞增量PI控制器（滤除磁强计量化抖动），在714.

title: Superconducting circuits host two-level systems with lifetimes exceeding one second
abstract: Understanding the microscopic environment of superconducting qubits is a central challenge for quantum technologies. Parasitic two-level systems (TLSs) of various microscopic origins are ubiquitous and limit qubit performance through decoherence, frequency drifts, and leakage. Recently, long-lived TLSs with lifetimes exceeding those of state-of-the-art qubits have been shown to induce correlated qubit dynamics, with direct implications for quantum error correction. Here, we perform wide-band quantum-jump correlation spectroscopy on flux-tunable transmon qubits and identify microscopic degrees of freedom that outlive the qubit by orders of magnitude. Pump-probe measurements at varying detunings from these objects reveal intrinsic lifetimes exceeding one second. Their weak coupling to the qubit, in the kilohertz range, is consistent with positional defects described by the standard tunneling model, without excluding other microscopic origins such as magnetic spin impurities or trapped quasiparticles. More broadly, these results establish superconducting qubits as a sensitive probe of exceptionally long-lived microscopic degrees of freedom and open a route toward their controlled access and functionalization.

summaries.en: Using wide-band quantum-jump correlation spectroscopy and pump-probe tests on flux-tunable transmon qubits, the authors identify parasitic two-level-system defects that outlive the qubits by orders of magnitude with intrinsic lifetimes over one second and weak kilohertz-range coupling consistent with standard tunneling-model positional defects, highlighting qubits as probes of long-lived microscopic degrees of freedom with implications for correlated dynamics and quantum error correction.
summaries.zh: 作者在通量可调的超导跨模特（transmon）量子比特上利用宽带量子跃迁关联谱学与不同失谐条件下的泵-探测实验，识别出寿命比量子比特长出数个数量级、固有寿命超过一秒的寄生两能级体系缺陷，其与量子比特的弱耦合处于千赫兹量级并与标准隧穿模型中的位置缺陷相符，同时也不排除磁性自旋杂质或俘获准粒子等其他微观来源，并指出量子比特可作为对超长寿命微观自由度的敏感探测器，从而与关联动力学及量子纠错具有直接意义。

title: Looking Beyond Visibility: Resolving the Temporal Structure of Continuous-Wave Four-Photon Hong-Ou-Mandel Interference
abstract: Hong-Ou-Mandel interference underpins many photonic quantum information protocols and is commonly characterized by a single visibility parameter. This quantity is typically obtained by averaging over a fixed coincidence window, thereby discarding details of the underlying temporal structure that are critical in continuous-wave processes. Four-photon interference with continuous-wave sources furthermore requires photon pairs with long coherence times, which we generate in microring resonators and measure with ultrafast time-resolved detection. Here, we model and resolve their interference and temporal structure by recording all four photon arrival times and mapping their relative delays onto a three-dimensional coincidence histogram relative to a trigger detection. The resulting structure preserves relative arrival-time correlations that are usually discarded and enables post-processed optimization of coincidence windows to trade off visibility against count rate. This method provides a general benchmark for continuous-wave sources in interference-based quantum network protocols.

summaries.en: The paper develops and experimentally validates a four-photon continuous-wave Hong–Ou–Mandel interference method that records all photon arrival times to reconstruct the full temporal correlation structure, enabling post-processed optimization of coincidence windows that trades off visibility and count rate beyond the usual single-visibility metric.
summaries.zh: 论文提出并实验验证了一种用于连续波四光子 Hong–Ou–Mandel 干涉的时间分辨方法：通过记录所有到达时间重建完整的时间相关结构，从而在常规单一“可见度”指标之外实现对符合窗口的后处理优化，进而在可见度与计数率之间进行权衡，并为连续波源的干涉型量子网络协议提供通用基准。

title: Quantum control of solid state qubits via Reinforcement Learning
abstract: The use of reinforcement learning (RL) in the design of quantum control strategies for pulse level control of NISQ era quantum devices is attracting growing interest. Model-free RL, not requiring preexisting knowledge of the physical system, acts as a black-box optimization tool well suited for noisy devices. In this work, we provide a simulation-based analysis of the performance of model-free RL for state preparation and qubit gate design in a challenging setup: indirect control of NV nuclear spins in a spin-bath. In particular, the spin-bath is modeled via the generalized cluster correlation expansion accounting for magnetic impurities and intra-bath interactions. We analyze the performance of the RL agents by performing simulations with minimally observable environments and noisy, sparse rewards as introduced in (Phys. Rev. X 12, 011059), and compare them to other state-of-the-art black-box optimization tools.

summaries.en: The paper uses simulation-based experiments to assess how model-free reinforcement learning can design pulse-level state preparation and gate operations for NV-based solid-state qubits under indirect control through a realistic spin-bath model, comparing minimally observable, sparse-reward performance against other black-box optimization methods.
summaries.zh: 本文通过仿真评估在通过自旋浴对 NV 固态量子比特进行间接控制的具体现实模型下，基于无模型的强化学习如何用于脉冲级态制备与量子门设计，并在最小可观测环境与稀疏奖励条件下与其他黑箱优化方法进行对比。

title: Thermal activation of photon catalysis in difference-intensity Mach-Zehnder interferometry with squeezed thermal light
abstract: Realistic non-Gaussian operations, which can be implemented by mixing a nonclassical Gaussian state with a Fock state at a beam splitter and then heralding on a photon-number-resolving detector, are known to improve phase estimation in a Mach-Zehnder interferometer. The existing studies have considered the single-mode squeezed vacuum for difference-intensity and parity detection, and the two-mode squeezed thermal state for parity detection alone as the initial Gaussian resources. However, a real squeezer in the lab actually produces single-mode squeezed thermal light, which has not been studied in a coherent-plus-resource interferometer. We take up this case and using the phase space Wigner picture, we obtain the heralded state produced by photon subtraction, addition and catalysis on a single-mode squeezed thermal resource, and evaluate the corresponding phase sensitivities. Single-photon catalysis, which is useless on squeezed vacuum, becomes a useful operation for any thermal occupation above $\nth\simeq0.2$, and since it heralds with a probability near one-half, it turns out to be the best success-weighted operation over the whole thermal range. In the vacuum limit our results reproduce the known hierarchy, where two-photon catalysis is the best operation. The quantum Fisher information computations confirms that thermal noise enhances the phase information encoded in the catalyzed state, demonstrating that difference-intensity detection closely approaches the ultimate precision bound across most operational regimes, and, together with a loss analysis, verifies the robustness of the effect.

summaries.en: The paper studies photon subtraction/addition/catalysis using a realistic single-mode squeezed thermal resource in a difference-intensity Mach-Zehnder interferometer, showing that single-photon catalysis becomes effective for thermal occupation above ~0.
summaries.zh: 论文在差强度马赫-曾德尔干涉仪中研究了在实验更真实的单模挤压热光资源上进行光子减/加与催化操作，表明当热占据数高于约0.

title: Loss-independent time-delay estimation via Hong-Ou-Mandel photon bunching detection
abstract: In this work we study the application of two-photon correlated quantum states for high-precision time estimation. To achieve this, photon pairs were fed into a Hong-Ou-Mandel polarization interferometer to generate N00N entangled states with $N = 2$. Two- and four-detector schemes were considered, and the achievable time estimation precision of each was studied, with particular emphasis on the system's Fisher information in each case. Our results reveal that using a four-detector scheme, enabling the measurement of both coincidence and photon-bunching terms, achieves the maximum precision given by the quantum Fisher information, without the need of characterizing system losses. We also show that correlations between repetitions arise due to systematic errors, limiting the precision enhancement that can be obtained by increasing the number of repetitions. Taking these correlations into account, we show that the four-detector scheme outperforms the two-detector scheme in the precision of time-delay estimation. With the experimentally determined calibration uncertainties, the four-detector scheme improves the dispersion by a factor of 2 for the repetitions performed, reaching up to a factor of 4 as both schemes approach their systematic floors.

summaries.en: The paper proposes and analyzes loss-independent time-delay estimation using N00N (N=2) two-photon states generated in a Hong–Ou–Mandel polarization interferometer, showing that a four-detector scheme measuring both coincidence and bunching achieves the quantum Fisher-information-limited precision without loss characterization and outperforms a two-detector scheme once systematic-induced correlations across repetitions are accounted for, with experiments showing up to 2×–4× dispersion improvements depending on repetition count.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出并分析利用在Hong–Ou–Mandel偏振干涉仪中制备的N00N（N=2）双光子纠缠态实现损耗无关的时间延迟估计，结果表明四探测器方案同时测量会聚/叠加（bunching）与共振（coincidence）项即可达到由量子费舍尔信息限定的最高精度且无需表征系统损耗，并且在考虑由系统误差导致的重复间相关性后，四探测器方案在时间延迟估计精度上优于两探测器方案；实验校准不确定度下，色散改进约为2倍（执行的重复次数下），当两方案接近其系统误差地板时可达4倍。

title: Energetic channels in finite many-body quantum charging
abstract: We examine how a finite many-body system can function as an effective charger for a single-qubit quantum battery, using the Lipkin-Meshkov-Glick model as a paradigmatic setting. As our figure of merit, we consider the battery ergotropy while explicitly resolving the energetic flows across the composite system. In the absence of intra-charger interactions, we show that the generation of non-zero ergotropy is controlled by the competition between collective coupling and spectral mismatch. We further demonstrate that even passive positive-temperature charger states can generate finite battery ergotropy, provided the charger is sufficiently large and sufficiently hot. Intra-charger interactions restructure the charger spectrum and qualitatively modify the available energetic pathways. While they can enhance the amount of energy accessible for charging, they can simultaneously divert energy into internal many-body and battery-charger interaction channels, producing an energetic impedance to direct charger-to-battery transfer. Consequently, battery ergotropy alone is insufficient to characterize an effective many-body charger: the useful work generated and its energetic provenance must be assessed together.

summaries.en: The paper analyzes how a finite many-body system modeled by the Lipkin-Meshkov-Glick model can act as an effective charger for a single-qubit battery by resolving ergotropy and the underlying energetic flow channels, finding that nonzero battery ergotropy arises from the competition between collective coupling and spectral mismatch, that even passive thermal charger states can yield finite ergotropy when the charger is large and hot, and that intra-charger interactions both open and obstruct charging by reshaping energy pathways and can create an energetic impedance, so battery ergotropy alone is not a sufficient metric without accounting for where the useful work comes from.
summaries.zh: 论文以Lipkin-Meshkov-Glick模型为例研究有限多体系统如何作为单量子比特电池的有效充电器，并通过显式解析能量流通道评估电池优势能（ergotropy），发现无组内相互作用时非零优势能受“集体耦合”与“谱不匹配”竞争所控；还表明即使充电器处于温度为正的被动态，只要充电器足够大且足够热也能产生有限优势能；而组内相互作用会重塑谱并在改变可用能量路径的同时可能增强可获得能量，却也会把能量分流到多体内部及电池-充电器耦合通道，从而产生对直接能量转移的能量阻抗，因此仅用电池优势能不足以表征有效性，还必须同时评估有用功及其能量来源。

title: Bubble-Sort Exchange Networks: Symmetry Selection Rules and Language-Model Distillation on Exchange-Only Spin Chains
abstract: On a chain of exchange-coupled quantum dots a Heisenberg exchange pulse of area pi is a SWAP, so the parallel bubble-sort SWAP network of superconducting chains is native to exchange-only (EO) spin qubits, and any other pulse area fuses routing with an entangling interaction. We build a variational "bubble-sort exchange network" (odd-even transposition, one parameter per pulse) and study it as a Born machine read out by Pauli spin blockade. Exchange conserves total spin, so the reachable readout distributions are fixed by the total-spin content of the initial product state. For the two-spin singlet-triplet encoding we derive a selection rule -- outcomes with k triplet pairs are bounded by the initial weight in sectors S <= k (S = 0 excluded for k = 1) -- and prove by a transportation argument that it is also sufficient: the reachable distributions form the polytope cut out by the rule, and its total-variation floor is attained. Products of singlets and T0's forbid whole outcome classes; the Neel state forbids none; the three-spin EO code has no floor. We then distil, in noise-free simulation, next-token distributions of GPT-2 over restricted vocabularies into the network, with matrix-product-state (MPS) Born machines as classical control. At six logical qubits the three-spin chain reaches KL = 0.011 nat at depth N and 0.004 at 2N, below the bond-dimension-4 MPS; the two-spin chain from the Neel state reaches 0.014 at 2N and 0.004 at 3N, against 0.28-1.5 from singlet/triplet products for the first teacher. Final states lie largely outside the code space: leakage is a resource, not an error. No arrangement of disjoint pulses meets every pair in fewer than N-1 rounds, and at depth 2N the chain distils as well as a 2D array or non-local couplings. Sector-restricted simulation extends this to 10-14 logical qubits (up to 30 dots).

summaries.en: The paper designs and analyzes a variational bubble-sort SWAP exchange network on exchange-only spin chains, derives total-spin–based selection rules that characterize which Pauli spin–blockade readout distributions are reachable, and uses MPS Born-machine control to distill GPT-2 token distributions into the device’s next-token statistics with low KL divergence while showing that final-state leakage can be beneficial and that sector-restricted simulations scale to up to 10–14 logical qubits (30 dots).
summaries.zh: 论文在交换型自旋链上构建并研究变分“冒泡排序”交换网络，通过总自旋守恒推导基于选择规则来刻画在泡利自旋阻塞下哪些读出分布可达，并借助基于 MPS 的 Born 机器作为经典控制将 GPT-2 的下一个词元分布蒸馏到该网络中取得较低的 KL 散度，同时表明末态泄漏可作为资源而非错误，并将扇区受限仿真扩展到最多 10–14 个逻辑量子比特（30 个量子点）。

title: Operational Limits of Gravity-Mediated Entanglement
abstract: Tests of gravity-mediated entanglement aim to determine whether two massive objects in spatial superposition can become entangled through their mutual gravitational interaction. In an ideal model, the two objects are often treated as pointlike branches, but real wave packets have a finite width and are also exposed to dephasing and residual non-gravitational forces. We study these effects in a two-branch gravitational cat-state model with Gaussian wave packets. The Newtonian interaction is averaged over the finite wave-packet width, and spatially correlated dephasing is included phenomenologically. We then ask a practical question: when does the generated state remain useful rather than merely entangled? To answer this, we examine Bell violation, teleportation fidelity, coherent information, Fisher information, and state distinguishability. We find finite parameter windows where the same state is Bell-nonlocal and teleportation-useful, but these windows shrink as the wave packets become broader or the dephasing becomes stronger. We also show that a residual electrostatic branch interaction can coherently cancel the gravitational nonlocal phase and strongly suppress the operational signal. The results identify finite-width and electrostatic tolerance boundaries that should be considered in future tests of gravity-mediated entanglement.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; General Relativity and Quantum Cosmology (gr-qc)

summaries.en: The paper models gravity-mediated entanglement between two spatially superposed masses using finite-width Gaussian wave packets and correlated dephasing, finding that although there are parameter ranges where the resulting state is simultaneously Bell-nonlocal and teleportation-useful, these operational windows shrink with increasing packet width or dephasing and can be strongly suppressed if a residual electrostatic interaction coherently cancels the gravitational nonlocal phase.
summaries.zh: 论文用有限宽度高斯波包并引入空间相关去相干的方式建模两处于空间叠加的质量物体之间的引力介导纠缠，结果表明虽然存在使态同时满足贝尔非局域与传送可用性的参数窗口，但该窗口会随波包变宽或去相干增强而缩小，并且一旦残余静电相互作用能相干地抵消引力非局域相位，操作信号还会被显著抑制。

title: Connectivity Bounds for GHZ Graphs
abstract: Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ) states are multipartite entangled quantum states that play a central role in quantum information theory, with applications in quantum communication, cryptography, and distributed quantum computing. A major experimental goal is to create high-dimensional GHZ states using multiple entangled parties. Krenn, Gu and Zeilinger discovered a surprising bridge between these quantum-optical experiments and graph theory: certain photonic experiments can be represented by edge-coloured, edge-weighted graphs, and the dimension of the produced GHZ state equals the number of feasible monochromatic inherited vertex colourings. This led Krenn and Gu to conjecture that every GHZ graph with more than four vertices has dimension at most $2$. A counterexample would give a new high-dimensional multipartite GHZ construction, while a proof would clarify fundamental resource limitations in quantum optics. It is known that the conjecture holds for graphs of vertex connectivity at most $2$ [MFCS 2024], and that simple GHZ graphs with $n>4$ vertices have dimension less than $n/\sqrt{2}$ [Quantum 2024]. However, no general upper bound depending only on vertex connectivity was known. We prove that every simple connected GHZ graph $G$ with at least four vertices has dimension at most $2^{\kappa(G)-1}+\binom{\kappa(G)}{2}$, where $\kappa(G)$ is the vertex connectivity of $G$. We also prove new bounds in terms of edge connectivity and maximum degree.

summaries.en: The paper proves that for any simple connected GHZ graph with at least four vertices, its GHZ-state dimension is bounded by 2^{κ(G)-1}+binom{κ(G)}{2}, where κ(G) is the graph’s vertex connectivity, and also derives related bounds using edge connectivity and maximum degree.
summaries.zh: 本文证明：对于至少四个顶点的简单连通GHZ图，其产生的GHZ态维数被 2^{κ(G)-1}+C(κ(G),2) 上界所限制，其中 κ(G) 为图的顶点连通度，并进一步给出了以边连通度和最大度数表示的相关上界。

title: Energetics of Fault-Tolerant Spin-Qubit Quantum Computation
abstract: Semiconductor spin qubits offer a promising route to compact and scalable quantum computers, combining long coherence times in isotopically purified silicon with compatibility with semiconductor manufacturing. Beyond computational speedup, their energy efficiency is an important consideration for future large-scale systems. We evaluate the power and energy requirements of a Loss-DiVincenzo spin-qubit quantum computer by analyzing the Quantum Fourier Transform (QFT) and benchmarking it against the classical Fast Fourier Transform (FFT). We develop a detailed energy budget, identifying cryogenic cooling as the dominant baseline contribution before quantum error correction (QEC). The comparison between the QFT and the classical FFT reveals that, for any quantum workload operating under a polynomially bounded sampling regime, the crossover in energy consumption occurs at smaller problem sizes than the crossover in execution time. Thus, quantum computing can become energetically competitive before achieving a speedup in execution time. We then incorporate surface-code QEC and analyze the energy costs of QEC cycles, gate synthesis, and decoding. At scale, instrumentation and decoding become dominant contributions, while cryogenic cooling imposes a constraint on scalability. We show that optimizing the control-signal demultiplexing ratio can reduce the overall energy cost by approximately two orders of magnitude. For a system with about one million physical qubits, we estimate a power consumption of approximately 100 kW, at least one order of magnitude below that of today's highest-performance classical computing systems.

summaries.en: The paper models and budgets the power and energy of a Loss-DiVincenzo spin-qubit quantum computer by comparing a quantum Fourier transform to a classical FFT, showing that energy competitiveness can arise at smaller problem sizes than execution-time crossover, and then quantifying how surface-code QEC, gate synthesis, decoding, and cryogenic cooling scale, with demultiplexing-ratio optimization enabling ~100 kW power for ~1 million physical qubits—about an order of magnitude below state-of-the-art classical systems.
summaries.zh: 论文通过将洛斯-迪文奇诺（Loss-DiVincenzo）自旋量子计算机中的量子傅里叶变换与经典快速傅里叶变换对比来建模并细化功耗与能量预算，表明在执行时间尚未出现加速优势之前能量层面可能已具竞争力；随后对引入表面码量子纠错后纠错周期、门合成与译码的能耗以及低温制冷的可扩展性约束进行量化，并通过优化控制信号分路比将总体能耗降低约两个数量级，估计约100万物理量子比特系统功耗约为100 kW，至少一个数量级低于当前最高性能经典计算系统。

title: Programmable all-to-all entangling gates for cavity-coupled atoms
abstract: Fault tolerant quantum computers greatly benefit from having both high fidelity entangling gates and a non-local qubit connectivity. However, most entangling gates for neutral atoms are local, requiring separated atoms to be moved using optical tweezers to yield entanglement between them. Here, we design a high fidelity Mølmer Sørensen-like entangling gate between neutral atoms coupled to a photonic cavity, enabling a programmable all-to-all connectivity through the shared cavity coupling. The gate is both robust to changes in cavity photon number, and enables selective entanglement between any subset of separated atoms through local laser addressing. This eliminates the need to physically move atoms to perform the gate, and therefore motional errors and erasure are suppressed. Using experimentally realistic parameters we demonstrate gate fidelities exceeding $F > 0.99$, with higher fidelities achievable through optimal control of the pump amplitudes.

summaries.en: The paper presents a high-fidelity, programmable Mølmer–Sørensen-like all-to-all entangling gate for cavity-coupled neutral atoms that uses shared cavity coupling and local laser addressing to entangle arbitrary atom subsets without moving them, suppressing motional errors and achieving experimentally realistic fidelities above F>0.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了一种面向腔耦合中性原子的高保真、可编程Mølmer–Sørensen类全到全纠缠门，利用共享腔耦合并结合局部激光寻址来对任意分离原子子集实现纠缠且无需移动原子，从而抑制运动误差并在实验可实现参数下实现F>0.

title: Magic in quantum trajectory unravelings of noisy random quantum circuits
abstract: The quantum-trajectory description of a noisy quantum circuit is not unique: every Kraus representation of the noise channel defines a different unraveling, i.e., a different ensemble of pure states that averages to the same density matrix. While all unravelings share the same expectation values of observables, they generally differ in the amount of quantum resources carried by the individual trajectories. Here we study non-stabilizerness, or magic, quantified by the stabilizer Rényi entropy, in quantum-trajectory unravelings of Haar-random and $T$-doped random Clifford brickwork circuits subject to local dephasing noise of strength $p$. The canonical unraveling in terms of Pauli jumps is Clifford and leaves magic untouched, so that trajectories retain the Haar-random value of non-stabilizerness. Exploring the full two-parameter family of minimal unravelings, we find that the trajectory-averaged magic can be substantially reduced by a state-independent choice of Kraus operators, and that the optimal choice is not in general the projective-measurement unraveling, but a two-outcome generalized measurement in which the Kraus operators correspond to a weak measurement of the noisy qubit. The optimal unraveling reduces the extensive magic density of the trajectories by a $p$-dependent factor without altering its linear scaling with system size. At the same time, it produces a very broad distribution of magic over trajectories, with a sizable fraction of trajectories retaining Haar-random magic. Since the cost of stabilizer-based classical simulation grows exponentially with the magic of the state, these high-magic trajectories, rather than the average, control the simulation cost. Our results delineate the potential and the limitations of unraveling optimization as a route to the classical simulation of noisy quantum dynamics with stabilizer methods.

summaries.en: The paper shows that different Kraus-operator choices for noisy quantum-circuit trajectories change how much stabilizer “magic” individual pure-state trajectories carry, finding that while Pauli-jump (Clifford) unravelings preserve Haar-random magic, a state-independent minimal unraveling based on two-outcome weak measurements can substantially reduce the trajectory-averaged magic without changing its linear system-size scaling, yet leaves a broad distribution where a nontrivial fraction of high-magic trajectories dominate the cost of stabilizer-based classical simulation.
summaries.zh: 论文表明，对噪声量子电路的量子轨迹用不同Kraus算符进行分解会改变各单个纯态轨迹所携带的稳定子“魔性”大小：Pauli跳跃（Clifford）分解会保持哈瓦随机魔性，而通过与态无关的最小分解并采用对应于对噪声比特弱测量的两结果广义测量，可显著降低轨迹平均魔性且不改变其随系统尺寸线性增长的标度，但轨迹魔性分布依然很宽，其中一部分高魔性轨迹主导基于稳定子的经典模拟代价。

title: A Rydberg atom array coupled to a high-cooperativity optical cavity
abstract: Integrating Rydberg-state control of atom-atom interactions with cavity control of atom-light interactions enables the combination of local entangling operations with photon-mediated long-range coupling, measurement, and communication. Such integration is challenging because electric fields generated by charges on cavity optics and by cavity-stabilizing actuators may disturb Rydberg-state coherence. Here, we couple a Rydberg tweezer array to a high-cooperativity optical cavity, suppressing the electric fields produced by cavity length actuation so that the residual field variation of about $3~\mathrm{mV/cm}$ rms does not limit Rydberg coherence. We demonstrate two capabilities that neither system provides alone. First, we use Purcell-enhanced fluorescence to read out atoms directly in the ground-Rydberg basis within $7.5~\mu\mathrm{s}$, well within the Rydberg-state lifetime, with ground- and Rydberg-state detection infidelities of $3\%$ and $5\%$, respectively, and with low atom loss. Second, we use Rydberg-Rydberg interactions to control collective light-atom scattering into the cavity mode. Specifically, we drive blockaded Rabi oscillations between a state with two ground-state atoms, which scatter collectively with a superradiant or subradiant rate controlled by the atomic positions, and an entangled state with a single Rydberg excitation, which scatters like a single atom. These capabilities open routes toward networked Rydberg processors, mid-circuit measurements in analog quantum simulators, and many-body quantum optics with entangled emitters coupled collectively to light.

summaries.en: The paper couples a Rydberg tweezer array to a high-cooperativity optical cavity by suppressing cavity-actuation electric-field noise (~3 mV/cm rms) to preserve Rydberg coherence, enabling fast ground–Rydberg readout via Purcell-enhanced fluorescence and position-dependent collective light–atom scattering controlled by Rydberg-Rydberg interactions, including blockaded Rabi oscillations producing superradiant/subradiant versus single-atom-like cavity emission for networked Rydberg processors and many-body quantum optics.
summaries.zh: 本文将里德堡光钳阵列与高保协度光学腔耦合，通过抑制腔长致动产生的电场噪声（约3 mV/cm rms）来保持里德堡相干性，并实现两项单独系统难以具备的功能：利用普朗克尔增强荧光在7.

title: Fast, parallel, three-dimensional rearrangement of atom arrays using superpositions of elementary holograms
abstract: Assembling defect-free arrays of neutral atoms requires real-time rearrangement of stochastically loaded optical tweezers. Conventional rearrangement methods shuttle atoms sequentially, whereas high-speed spatial light modulators (SLMs) can move all atoms in parallel, which scales more favorably as the array size grows. For fast parallel rearrangement, the sequence of holograms displayed on the SLM should be computed more rapidly than the SLM refresh rate, and there should be phase continuity between successive holograms to minimize transient intensity fluctuations. We calculate holograms analytically by adding together the complex fields needed to produce each individual trap, and we ramp the phase of each trap linearly as it moves to its target location. Trap positions enter as continuous variables, rather than tied to points on a grid, so the method provides high positioning accuracy. Using a single GPU, we compute each intermediate hologram in 0.284 ms, considerably faster than the SLM refresh time of 0.696 ms, so the rearrangement speed is hardware-limited. In each step, we use the free processing time to iteratively optimize the holograms for equal intensity across the traps, decreasing trap non-uniformity to 1.24% during rearrangement at no cost in total time. Starting from an array of 256 sites loaded stochastically with $^{87}$Rb atoms, we assemble a 100-atom array in under 20 ms with a rearrangement survival probability of 99.31(12)% per atom. This rearrangement increases the temperature of the atoms by 9(3) $\mu$K, which is small compared to the trap depth of 480 $\mu$K. Our method can also move individual atoms axially, enabling transport in different planes. We demonstrate this capability with a rearrangement protocol where one set of atoms leapfrogs over another.

summaries.en: The paper presents a GPU-accelerated method for fast, phase-continuous, parallel 3D rearrangement of neutral-atom optical tweezers using superpositions of elementary holograms with continuous (non-grid) trap positions, enabling near real-time assembly of a defect-free 100-atom array from 256 stochastic 87Rb sites in under 20 ms with high survival and low heating.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种利用单个GPU计算、相位连续且并行的三维重排光镊原子阵列的方法，通过叠加基本全息图并采用连续而非网格化的陷阱位置来实现快速重排，从256个随机装载的87Rb位点在20毫秒内组装出100原子阵列，具有高存活率与较小升温，并展示了可在不同平面进行轴向单原子移动及交错越位的能力。
